fatal_failures: production or authored tests do not compile and run from a clean offline copy
the caller-visible ReconcileSettlementStatus operation is absent
the implementation uses no genuine generated CDM 7.0.0 TradeState at its boundary
an update changes a non-target book entry or mutates a prior snapshot
identical replay emits a second audit entry or conflicting event-id reuse is accepted
operational SETTLED or FAILED status silently terminates or changes the economics of the CDM trade

criteria.description: Implement the supplied operational state machine and preconditions exactly.
checks: Every allowed transition succeeds and every unlisted transition rejects before any result escapes.
SETTLED is terminal, FAILED can be repaired to MATCHED, and FAILED requires a non-blank reason.
Effective timestamps come from the update and back-dated updates reject deterministically.

criteria.description: Make replay idempotent by both event identity and content.
checks: Replaying an accepted event with identical content returns the prior semantic result without a second audit line.
Reusing its event identifier with different target, time, status, or reason rejects visibly.
Replay behavior survives a new engine instance because it is represented in returned state rather than mutable process globals.

criteria.description: Change only the selected entry while preserving old snapshots as values.
checks: One target in a reordered three-entry same-counterparty book produces exactly one changed entry and one audit line.
Unknown and duplicated trade identifiers fail before constructing a partially revised book.
Mutating caller-owned construction lists or an exposed result collection cannot alter old or new snapshots.
Unchanged CDM values, application histories, and bystander entries remain equal to their inputs.

criteria.description: Use a defensible generated boundary without assigning application settlement policy to CDM.
checks: Every entry carries a genuine CDM 7.0.0 TradeState with stable documented identity resolution.
Operational status, failure reason, replay ledger, and audit line remain explicit application facts.
SETTLED and FAILED preserve the input CDM trade lifecycle and economics rather than constructing a ClosedState as operational shorthand.
DESIGN.md states whether each fixture is a complete root or deliberately partial and names only validation actually executed.

criteria.description: Prove the declared boundary and failure paths rather than relying on validation theatre.
checks: Any claimed complete CDM root has applicable root and populated-child conditions executed through working runtime wiring.
A deliberately invalid populated generated child fails specifically; a labelled partial fixture is not misreported as wholly valid.
Application validation still runs for missing identities, reasons, histories, timestamps, and unsupported enum/null inputs.

criteria.description: Deliver deterministic, compact code with proportionate dependency inspection.
checks: Clean offline tests pass without current-clock, default-zone, mutable-static, or hash-only replay behavior.
The implementation uses bounded source/API queries and does not bulk-extract the generated source JAR into the project.
Public value types expose immutable collections and unambiguous equality/content semantics.
